title: 第19章 情感咨询大师姜恒宇叶凡的抉择第20章 昆仑成仙地娲帝尸通灵
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
一年时间匆匆而过。
叶凡在这一年时间里做了很多事情。
他仗着自身已经开辟了苦海，于是便打算探索一下地球的玄妙，因为他觉得地球或许非常不凡，可能与古今的几位大帝天尊有关……
根据群友所言。
道德天尊、元始天尊、灵宝天尊都是真实存在的人物，他们是神话时代的三位无上天尊。
而地球也有关于三清的传说。
或许……
神话时代的三位天尊曾经降临过地球！？
在这一年时间里。
叶凡探索了国内的诸多名山。
他曾深入秦岭，也曾在神农架修行过一段时间，后来更是来到了万山之祖的昆仑山……
最后。
他还真发现了一些不对劲。
叶凡在昆仑山内发现了少许的天地精气。
很少。
少的可怜。
但是在地球却十分难得。
地球处于末法时代，这一点叶凡心中清楚，他当初修炼的时候发现天地间压根没有多少精气，于是便找万能的群友询问了一番——
最后得出结论。
地球已经进入了末法时代。

修行之路彻底埋葬在了过去的岁月中。
或许。
地球也曾辉煌过。
叶凡在昆仑山内探索了很久。
但他始终没有发现半点的线索，除了那少许的精气之外，他一无所获，什么都没发现。
叶凡有些困惑。
他的直觉告诉他昆仑山绝对不简单。
毕竟，
这可是万山之祖啊。
他既然发现不了其中的玄妙。
那只能说他的修为太低了，压根无法察觉到昆仑山的不对劲。
所以……
“是时候询问万能的群友了！”
叶凡打算咨询一下人皇，如果神话时代的三位天尊真的降临过地球，那么地球在过去的岁月中肯定不是什么籍籍无名的星球，说不定人皇真的知道什么呢。
content_en:
A year flies by.
Ye Fan has done a lot of things in this year.
He relied on himself to open up the sea of suffering, so he planned to explore the mysteries of the earth, because he felt that the earth might be very extraordinary and might be related to several great emperors and gods in ancient and modern times...
According to what friends said.
Daode Tianzun, Yuanshi Tianzun, and Lingbao Tianzun are all real characters. They are the three supreme gods in the mythical age.
The earth also has legends about the Three Pure Ones.
Maybe...
Three gods from the mythical age once visited the earth! ?
During this year.
Ye Fan explored many famous mountains in the country.
He went deep into the Qinling Mountains, practiced in Shennongjia for a period of time, and later came to the Kunlun Mountains, the ancestor of all mountains...
Finally.
He really noticed something was wrong.
Ye Fan discovered a little bit of heaven and earth essence in Kunlun Mountain.
rare.
Too few.
But it is very rare on earth.
The earth is in the end of the Dharma era. Ye Fan knows this in his heart. When he first practiced, he found that there was not much essence in the world, so he asked the omnipotent group of friends -
Finally draw a conclusion.
The earth has entered the Age of Ending Dharma.
The path of spiritual practice is completely buried in the past years.
perhaps.
The earth has also been glorious.
Ye Fan has been exploring the Kunlun Mountains for a long time.
But he never found any clues. Except for a little bit of energy, he found nothing and nothing.
Ye Fan was a little confused.
His intuition told him that Kunlun Mountain was definitely not simple.
After all,
This is the ancestor of all mountains.
Since he couldn't discover the mystery.
It can only be said that his cultivation level is too low and he cannot detect anything wrong with Kunlun Mountain at all.
So...
“It’s time to ask the almighty group of friends!”
Ye Fan plans to consult the Human Emperor. If the three gods from the mythical era really came to the earth, then the earth must not have been an unknown planet in the past years. Maybe the Human Emperor really knows something.
